effect.u_message: The survey journal ends in mid-sentence. A chalk diagram links the specimen case to the disturbances in the forest. The tents were torn from outside; nobody finished packing.
Names have been scraped from the memorial. Beneath the altar, black wax covers a chain of handprints. A narrow side aisle leads around the nave; the bell mechanism is in the western tower.
Drag marks lead from the stripped camp into the sunken hollow. The creature has dragged its victims behind the broken stone screens. The supply bundle lies off the main approach.

The ruined foundation has split around a living fissure. Ash covers the approach, but the central wound is still open. Sealing it will suppress new manifestations nearby, not remove creatures already here.
Broken shields, shackles and stolen clothing hang beside the training yard. The prisoners scratched an escape route around the tents. Beyond the stone screens lies the leader's fighting ground.
Tiny shoes and torn toys lie under flowers that grow around the cocoons. This promise of paradise ended here. Some cocoons are split and empty; sealed ones still move.
Notes on herbs and wards lie beside unfinished repairs. The west road and southern garden are kept clear. Take time to prepare before agreeing to the attack; these two routes are meant for escape.

The standard survived a siege that melted its fittings. Broken ramparts offer cover on the approach. Inside the crucible, leave the marked breath line during preparation; the dragon cannot turn the shot after aiming.
